import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(15, 12))
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Data Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Top breeds distribution
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
breed_counts = pd.concat([
    df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts(),
    df['Rasse2Text'].value_counts()
]).groupby(level=0).sum().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10)
breed_counts.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax1, color='steelblue')
ax1.set_xlabel('Count')
ax1.set_ylabel('Breed')
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Dog Breeds')
ax1.invert_yaxis()

ax2 = axes[0, 1]
age_data = df['AlterVHundLang'].value_counts().sort_index()
age_data.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax2, color='coral')
ax2.set_xlabel('Dog Age')
ax2.set_ylabel('Count')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution of Dogs')
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
